verdict.rationale: Synctera's Webhook API lets integrators subscribe to specific platform events and receive pushed updates, and scheduled payments provide time-based automation. Users can build event-triggered actions themselves on top of these, but the evidence shows no native rules engine for defining conditions and actions within the platform. Missing for 10: a first-party rule/condition builder, platform-executed automatic actions on events, and documentation or hands-on corroboration of rule-based automation.
